decks.notes: The main focus of this deck is to utilize the combo of Phyrexian Dreadnought and Stifle to deny the opponent's possible responses while quickly deploying a massive creature onto the battlefield. The deck includes various ways to control the game, such as counterspells and bounce spells like Boomerang and Fire/Ice, along with card draw and filtering through cards like Impulse and Gush. Additionally, the inclusion of burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Grim Lavamancer provides a way to deal with threats or finish off the opponent. The deck also has some land manipulation with Barbarian Ring and flexible mana sources to support the combo.

This deck focuses on aggressive gameplay and disruption, aiming to quickly deal damage to the opponent while also eliminating their resources. It includes a mix of powerful creatures like Spectral Lynx, Exalted Angel, and Hypnotic Specter, along with removal spells like Disenchant, Smother, Swords to Plowshares, and Gerrard's Verdict to control the board. The deck also utilizes Dark Ritual to generate extra mana and enable quicker plays. Additionally, it incorporates cards like Vindicate and Wasteland to destroy the opponent's threats and lands, while Phyrexian Arena provides consistent card advantage.

This deck aims to quickly establish a board presence using efficient creatures like Werebear, Nimble Mongoose, and Terravore. By using cards like Weathered Wayfarer and Sylvan Safekeeper to protect its threats, it can quickly overwhelm opponents. The deck also includes ramp spells like Mox Diamond and Birds of Paradise to accelerate its game plan. Armageddon acts as a disruptive element, resetting the game state and potentially leaving opponents unable to recover. The deck includes some utility spells like Swords to Plowshares and Sylvan Library to further support its aggressive strategy.

The deck focuses on using control elements like Winter Orb and Tangle Wire to slow down the opponent while using cards like Survival of the Fittest and Sylvan Library to search for key creatures. The goal is to establish a board presence with resilient creatures like Shield Sphere and Quirion Ranger, while eventually setting up a win condition with cards like Triskelion or Phyrexian Colossus. The deck also has cards like Solitary Confinement and Seal of Cleansing for protection and removal. Overall, the deck aims to outlast and outvalue the opponent through careful resource management and strategic play.

This deck focuses on quickly developing mana with cards like Fyndhorn Elves and Llanowar Elves to ramp into powerful elves like Priest of Titania and Multani's Acolyte. The deck also includes key cards like Wirewood Symbiote to protect and reuse creatures, while also running Tangle Wire to disrupt the opponent. Survival of the Fittest provides tutoring for essential creatures, while Biorhythm can help close out the game by overwhelming the opponent with a massive mana advantage. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a fast and aggressive elf tribal strategy.

The core idea of this deck is to quickly and efficiently assemble a win condition using various combo pieces. The key strategy revolves around utilizing cards like Hermit Druid and Survival of the Fittest to fill up the graveyard with key combo pieces, while also being able to constantly manipulate and recur them. By combining different creatures with abilities like Volrath's Shapeshifter and Phyrexian Devourer, the deck can create powerful and game-ending combos. The deck also includes disruptive elements such as Cabal Therapy and Duress to disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The main goal of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent quickly by flooding the board with aggressive goblin creatures and utilizing their tribal synergy to deal damage efficiently. The deck aims to establish early board presence with creatures like Goblin Lackey and Goblin Matron, then further strengthen the board with cards like Goblin Ringleader and Siege-Gang Commander. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Gempalm Incinerator and Goblin Sharpshooter provide additional removal and control options, while cards like Skirk Prospector and Wasteland help maintain tempo and disrupt the opponent's strategy.

The main focus of this deck is to disrupt the opponent's strategy by controlling the board with cards like Sphere of Resistance and Winter's Grasp while utilizing Oath of Druids to bring out powerful creatures like Terravore. The deck aims to ramp up mana quickly with cards like Wild Growth and Exploration while also utilizing land destruction with Wasteland and Rishadan Port. The strategy revolves around using these control elements to establish a strong board presence and overwhelm the opponent.

This deck focuses on controlling the game by using counterspells, removal spells, and creatures with abilities that disrupt opponents' strategies. The goal is to slow down the opponent's progress while building up a board presence with creatures like Lin Sivvi, Defiant Hero and Mother of Runes. Standstill and Ramosian Sergeant are used to generate card advantage, while Mishra's Factory provides a resilient threat. The deck's main strategy is to outlast the opponent by efficiently controlling the game until it can secure a victory.

This deck focuses on aggressively disrupting the opponent's strategy while applying pressure with efficient creatures. With cards like Hypnotic Specter and Nantuko Shade to quickly deplete the opponent's hand and life total, along with removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Vindicate to keep the board clear. The deck also includes Phyrexian Arena for card advantage and Wasteland to disrupt the opponent's mana base. By constantly applying pressure and disruption, this deck aims to control the game and secure a fast victory.

The main focus of this Goblins deck is to overwhelm the opponent with fast, aggressive creatures. By using cards like Goblin Lackey and Goblin Matron to quickly get creatures onto the battlefield, combined with Goblin Warchief to reduce costs and give haste, the deck aims to quickly build a threatening board presence. Cards like Goblin Piledriver and Siege-Gang Commander provide additional power, while utility cards like Gempalm Incinerator and Naturalize help control the opponent's board. The deck thrives on quick, efficient plays and leveraging the synergies between Goblin creatures to secure victory.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game by utilizing cards like Standstill, Counterspell, Swords to Plowshares, and Mana Leak to disrupt the opponent's strategy while maintaining card advantage. The deck also focuses on using land destruction with cards like Dust Bowl and Mox Diamond to limit the opponent's resources. The inclusion of win conditions like Decree of Justice and Humility helps to close out the game once the opponent's resources have been depleted. This deck aims to outlast the opponent and secure victory through careful control and resource management.

This deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly with cards like Exploration, Wild Growth, and Oath of Druids, and then using control elements like Wasteland and Rishadan Port to disrupt the opponent's strategy. Terravore serves as a win condition, while Sphere of Resistance slows down the opponent's spells. Winter's Grasp and Thermokarst provide removal options, while cards like Sylvan Library and Mulch help with card draw and deck thinning. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and disruption to secure victory.

The main strategy of this deck is to control the game through disruption with cards like Sphere of Resistance and Cataclysm, while using Oath of Druids to cheat out powerful creatures like Terravore. The deck also includes cards like Swords to Plowshares and Seal of Cleansing for removal and disruption. The mana base is designed to support the control elements of the deck, with lands like Rishadan Port and Wasteland to disrupt the opponent's mana base. Overall, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up powerful and difficult to deal with threats.

The main idea behind this deck is to control the game using spells like Swords to Plowshares and Cataclysm, while also utilizing the Oath of Druids card to bring out powerful creatures like Terravore and Exalted Angel. The deck also includes cards like Sphere of Resistance and Mox Diamond to disrupt the opponent's strategy, and lands like Treetop Village and Rishadan Port to provide mana and additional effects. The overall strategy is to create a strong board presence and outmaneuver the opponent through control and powerful creatures.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly and aggressively deal damage to the opponent using fast and efficient creatures like Jackal Pup and Mogg Fanatic, as well as burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Incinerate. With the use of Ball Lightning and Fireblast, this deck aims to close out the game swiftly before the opponent has a chance to stabilize. The inclusion of utility cards like Sulfuric Vortex and Cursed Scroll help ensure a steady stream of damage throughout the game. The mana base consists of fetch lands and basic Mountains to support the low mana curve.
